"""
	Transforms the provided date value based on user-selected options for 
	period and shift.
	
	Args:
	    value (Date): The date value to transform.
	    quality (Quality): The quality of the data (not used in this function).
	    timestamp (Timestamp): The timestamp of the value (not used in this function).
	
	Returns:
	    Date: The transformed date based on the selected options.
	"""
	
	def set_datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute=0, second=0):
	    """Helper function to set the date and time."""
	    date = system.date.getDate(year, month, day)
	    return system.date.setTime(date, hour, minute, second)
	"""
	# Test hour
	value = set_datetime(2024, 9, 22, 15)
	print value
	shift = "B"
	dropDownPeriod = 5  # 0: Turno A, 1: Turno B, 2: Turno C, 3: Previous Day, 4: Current Day, 5: Weeks, 6: Months, 7: Custom
	endTime = set_datetime(2020, 10, 2, 21)
	"""
	
	Year = system.date.getYear(value)
	Month = system.date.getMonth(value)
	Day = system.date.getDayOfMonth(value)
	Hour = system.date.getHour24(value)
	Min = system.date.getMinute(value)
	
	
	# Variables to hold user selections
	endTime = self.getChild("FlexContainer_reasonsAssignment").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexContainer_Line_Equipment_Function_Type").getChild("DateTimeInput_EndTime").props.value
	shift = self.custom.shift
	dropDownPeriod = self.getChild("FlexContainer_reasonsAssignment").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexContainer_Line_Equipment_Function_Type").getChild("Dropdown Periodo").props.value
	
	
	# Process the selected period
	if dropDownPeriod == 7:  # Custom selected
	    value = endTime
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Selecting Shift A
	    # Siempre termina a las 05:59:59 del siguiente día
	    if shift == 'A':
	        if Hour >= 22:  # Parte inicial del turno A (22-23h)
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day + 1, 5, 59, 59)
	        else:  # Parte final del turno A (00-05h)
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'B':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'C':
			value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Selecting Shift B
	    # Siempre termina a las 13:59:59 del mismo día
	    if shift == 'A':
	        if Hour >= 22:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 13, 59, 59)
	        else:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day-1, 13, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'B':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 13, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'C':
	        if Hour < 6:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day - 1, 13, 59, 59)
	        else:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 13, 59, 59)
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 2:  # Selecting Shift C
	    # Siempre termina a las 21:59:59 del mismo día
	    if shift == 'A':
	        if Hour >= 22:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 21, 59, 59)
	        else:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day-1, 21, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'B':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 21, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'C':
	        if Hour < 6:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day - 1, 21, 59, 59)
	        else:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 21, 59, 59)
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 3:  # Selecting Previous Day
	    # Fin de día = 05:59:59
	    if Hour < 6:  # Entre 0:00 y 5:59
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day - 1, 5, 59, 59)
	    else:
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)
	
	else:  # Default case, usar hora y minuto actual
	    value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, Hour, Min, 0)
		    
	return value

# startTime
	
	"""
	Transforms the provided date value based on user-selected options for 
	period and shift.
	
	Args:
	    value (Date): The date value to transform.
	    quality (Quality): The quality of the data (not used in this function).
	    timestamp (Timestamp): The timestamp of the value (not used in this function).
	
	Returns:
	    Date: The transformed date based on the selected options.
	"""
	
	def set_datetime(year, month, day, hour):
		"""Helper function to set the date and time."""
		date = system.date.getDate(year, month, day)
		return system.date.setTime(date, hour, 0, 0)
	"""
	# Test hour
	value = set_datetime(2024, 9, 22, 7)
	print value
	shift = "A"
	dropDownPeriod = 5  # 0: Turno A, 1: Turno B, 2: Turno C, 3: Previous Day, 4: Current Day, 5: Weeks, 6: Months, 7: Custom
	startTime = set_datetime(2020, 10, 2, 21)
	"""
	year = system.date.getYear(value)
	month = system.date.getMonth(value)
	day = system.date.getDayOfMonth(value)
	hour = system.date.getHour24(value)
	dayOfWeek = system.date.getDayOfWeek(value)
	#print dayOfWeek
	
	# Variables to hold user selections
	dropDownPeriod = self.getChild("FlexContainer_reasonsAssignment").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexContainer_Line_Equipment_Function_Type").getChild("Dropdown Periodo").props.value
	shift = self.custom.shift
	startTime = self.getChild("FlexContainer_reasonsAssignment").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexContainer_Line_Equipment_Function_Type").getChild("DateTimeInput_StartTime").props.value
	
	# Process the selected period
	if dropDownPeriod != 7:  # Assuming '7' represents a custom option
		if dropDownPeriod == 4:  # Current Day
			# Use current day's start time if after 6 AM; otherwise, use the previous day's
			newDate = set_datetime(year, month, day if hour >= 6 else day - 1, 6)
			value = newDate
	
		elif dropDownPeriod == 3:  # Previous Day
			# Use the previous day's start time based on current hour
			newDate = set_datetime(year, month, day - (1 if hour >= 6 else 2), 6)
			value = newDate
			
		elif dropDownPeriod == -1:  # No specific selection (consider using a different value)
			value = set_datetime(year, month, day, hour)
			
		elif dropDownPeriod == 6:  # Months
			value = set_datetime(year, month, 1, 6)
		
		elif dropDownPeriod == 5:  # Weeks
			# Calculate the day of the week (1: Sunday, 7: Saturday)
			dayOfWeek = system.date.getDayOfWeek(system.date.getDate(year, month, day))
		
			# Calculate the previous Monday
			if dayOfWeek == 2:  # If it is Monday (Day 2)	
				if hour >= 6:
					previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -dayOfWeek + 2)
				else:
					# Go back one week (7 days)
					previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -7)
		    
	
			elif dayOfWeek > 2:
				previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -dayOfWeek + 2)
				
			else:
				previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -6)
		
			# Set the time to 6:00:00
			value = set_datetime(system.date.getYear(previousMonday), system.date.getMonth(previousMonday), system.date.getDayOfMonth(previousMonday), 6)
		    
		# Nuevo esquema de turnos
		# A: 22:00 - 05:59
		# B: 06:00 - 13:59
		# C: 14:00 - 21:59
		
		if shift == 'A':
		    if dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Seleccionando A mientras estoy en A
		        # 22:00 del día actual si >= 22h, sino del día anterior
		        if hour >= 22:
		            value = set_datetime(year, month, day, 22)
		        else:
		            value = set_datetime(year, month, day - 1, 22)
		
		    elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Seleccionando B mientras estoy en A
		        # 06:00 del día actual si ya pasó medianoche, sino día anterior
		        if hour >= 22:  # estoy en la parte "del mismo día" del turno A
		            value = set_datetime(year, month, day, 6)
		        else:
		            value = set_datetime(year, month, day-1, 6)
		
		    elif dropDownPeriod == 2:  # Seleccionando C mientras estoy en A
		        if hour >= 22:
		            value = set_datetime(year, month, day, 14)
		        else:
		            value = set_datetime(year, month, day-1, 14)
		
		elif shift == 'B':
		    if dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Seleccionando A mientras estoy en B
					value = set_datetime(year, month, day-1, 22)
		
		    elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Seleccionando B mientras estoy en B
		        value = set_datetime(year, month, day, 6)
		
		    elif dropDownPeriod == 2:  # Seleccionando C mientras estoy en B
		        value = set_datetime(year, month, day-1, 14)
		
		elif shift == 'C':
		    if dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Seleccionando A mientras estoy en C
		        value = set_datetime(year, month, day-1, 22)
		
		    elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Seleccionando B mientras estoy en C
		        value = set_datetime(year, month, day, 6)
		
		    elif dropDownPeriod == 2:  # Seleccionando C mientras estoy en C
		        value = set_datetime(year, month, day, 14)
	
	else:
	    # Si el dropdown period es 7, usar la hora de inicio como valor
	    value = startTime
	return value
